record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: HATENNA (1 star), HATTREM (2 stars) and HATTERENE (3 stars), the queued units; maxPP 100, range 1 for all three.
record.summary: Self shield plus silence of adjacent enemies. The caster gains a shield of 15 / 30 / 60 / 120 (requested, by caster stars) scaled by its AP and by crit, and every enemy-team entity in the up-to-8 cells adjacent to the caster is silenced for 2000 / 3000 / 4000 / 8000 ms (requested, by caster stars). The silence duration is not AP- or crit-scaled. No damage is dealt. A silenced unit cannot cast and gains no positive PP. The cast target itself is not used: the effect is centred on the caster, but requiresTarget is the default true, so the caster still needs a target in range to start the cast.

targeting.who: the caster (shield); enemy-team entities in the cells adjacent to the caster (silence)
targeting.note: the passed target is ignored by the effect; the area is the caster's neighbourhood

geometry.shape: the 8 cells around the caster (centre excluded), clipped to the board
geometry.detail: board.getAdjacentCells(x, y) with includesCenter = false; only cells with an entity whose team differs from the caster's are affected

effects.scaling: requested amount: addShield(shield, pokemon, 1, crit): apBoost 1 gives x(1 + AP/100); the crit multiplier applies when the cast crit (needs ABILITY_CRIT, canCritByDefault is false)
effects.resolution: applied amount: PokemonEntity.addShield first runs applyBigEaterBeltStatBuff (x1.25 rounded down, only when the caster holds Big Eater Belt and the value is positive), then PokemonState.addShield: nothing if the caster is at 0 hp, x0.5 if the caster is enraged, Math.round, added to the existing shield. Order is Big Eater Belt, then AP, crit, enraged

effects.target: enemy-team entities in the 8 adjacent cells
effects.scaling: none: the duration is passed to triggerSilence unchanged by the strategy; no AP or crit scaling
effects.resolution: applied duration: triggerSilence does nothing if the target has runeProtect or is a tree; x1.3 in MURKY weather; then SWIFT_SWIM x0.7 or HYDRATION x0.5 or WATER_VEIL / SURGE_SURFER x0.3 (first match), then Odd Keystone x(1 - 0.1 per stone) on the target's player; rounded. The status keeps the longer of the old and new cooldown

statusEffects.combatEffect: canCast is false while silenced (and while holding Nullify Bandanna), and addPP ignores positive PP gains while silenced

starBehavior.note: both tables are indexed by the caster's stars (stars-1); the 4-star entries (120 / 8000) and fallbacks are not reached by the listed units.

record.positionalConditions: The silence only reaches enemy-team entities standing in one of the up to 8 cells adjacent to the caster at cast time; the shield is applied regardless of neighbours.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state or modes. Shields stack additively on repeated casts; a new silence only replaces the cooldown if longer.
record.rawVsResolved: Requested shield 15 / 30 / 60 and silence 2000 / 3000 / 4000 ms. Applied shield = Big Eater Belt x1.25 (round down) if held, then x(1 + AP/100), x crit factor, x0.5 if enraged, rounded. Applied silence = requested ms after the Murky weather, status-duration reductions and Odd Keystone; rune protection or tree status blocks it. No damage and no takenDamage involved.
